cohort: 294,598 women in Norway with their first and second singleton delivery during 1996-2015
finding: A previous cesarean delivery was associated with an increased risk of stillbirth and perinatal death compared to a previous vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: This cohort study found that women with a previous cesarean delivery had an increased risk of stillbirth, perinatal death, and potentially cerebral palsy in their subsequent pregnancy compared to women with a previous vaginal delivery.
